relationships.subject: miR-605
relationships.evidence_quote: Our luciferase reporter assay confirmed that miR-605 bound to the 3’UTR of CXCL5 and downregulated its expression.

relationships.subject: miR-605
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, miR-605-mediated downregulation of CXCL5 reduced chemotaxis of THP-1 monocytes.

relationships.subject: CXCL5
relationships.evidence_quote: CXCL5 promotes chemotaxis and acute inflammation by binding to the CXCR2 chemokine receptor on the surface of immune cells.

relationships.subject: STAT3
relationships.evidence_quote: STAT3 binds to the promoter regions inducing upregulation of three chemokines including CXCL5, which in turn could regulate the recruitment of peripheral immune cells [42].

key_findings: miR-605 is downregulated in CRPS ketamine poor responders and directly targets the CXCL5 3'UTR; inhibiting miR-605 raises CXCL5 secretion and monocyte chemotaxis.
CXCL5 mRNA is higher in poor responders and CXCL5 protein is elevated in plasma of CRPS patients.
